title: BugSpotter generated debugging exercises
summary: Students inspect LLM-generated buggy code and design failing test cases that expose its errors. The exercise asks them to reason from a problem specification, hypothesize faults, and verify those hypotheses instead of repairing a supplied bug directly.

sources.title: From Automation to Cognition: Redefining the Roles of Educators and Generative AI in Computing Education
sources.evidence_quote: The tool generates buggy code based on a problem specification and requires students to design failing test cases that reveal the errors.

assessment.summary: Students inspect LLM-generated buggy code and design failing test cases that expose its errors.
student_actions: Read a problem specification and generated buggy program.
Design test cases that reveal the bugs.
Verify the tests against the program.
